# PayFit

> PayFit is a comprehensive UK payroll and HR automation platform that streamlines compliance, employee management, and financial operations for SMEs and growing businesses.

PayFit provides integrated payroll software with HMRC RTI compliance, HR management, expense tracking, and leave management. The platform serves businesses of all sizes from founders to medium enterprises, with AI-powered support and seamless integrations with accounting software like Xero and Netsuite.

## Key Topics

- Payroll automation
- HMRC compliance
- RTI submissions
- HR management
- Employee onboarding
- Leave management
- Expense management
- Payroll integrations
- Xero integration
- Performance management
- AI Copilot
- Small business solutions
- SME payroll
- UK payroll software
- Employee portal
